days.title: Begin with wonder
days.reflection: Creation invites us to receive this day as a gift rather than a possession. Wonder makes room for humility and attentive care.
days.practice: Notice one ordinary thing with patient attention and give thanks for it.
days.prayer: Creator, teach me to welcome today with wonder and to care for what you have made.

days.title: Ask for wisdom
days.reflection: Wisdom grows when we admit what we do not know and remain willing to learn. Honest questions can become a doorway to faithful action.
days.practice: Name one decision before you and ask a trusted person for a thoughtful perspective.
days.prayer: God of wisdom, clear my motives and guide my next faithful step.

days.title: Practice gratitude
days.reflection: Gratitude does not deny difficulty; it keeps difficulty from becoming the whole story. Remembered gifts strengthen us for present work.
days.practice: Write down three specific gifts from the last twenty-four hours.
days.prayer: Giver of every good gift, open my eyes to grace already present.

days.title: Choose mercy
days.reflection: Mercy sees a person as more than one mistake or one hard moment. It joins truth with patience and leaves space for repair.
days.practice: Respond gently in one situation where impatience would be easier.
days.prayer: Merciful God, make my words truthful, patient, and ready to restore.

days.title: Carry burdens together
days.reflection: No one is meant to carry every weight alone. Shared attention can turn isolation into courage without pretending to solve everything.
days.practice: Ask someone how they are doing, listen without interruption, and offer one concrete help.
days.prayer: God of compassion, make me present to others and humble enough to receive help too.

days.title: Rest and listen
days.reflection: Rest is not an escape from meaningful work; it restores the attention that good work requires. Silence can reveal what hurry conceals.
days.practice: Set aside ten quiet minutes without a screen, task, or plan.
days.prayer: God of peace, quiet my hurry and renew my attention.

days.title: Walk in hope
days.reflection: Hope is not certainty about every outcome. It is the courage to take the next loving step while trusting that our work is not wasted.
days.practice: Choose one small act of repair or encouragement and do it today.
days.prayer: God of hope, fill me with steady courage for the path ahead.
